sentences.text: This first bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the applicant Sonu @ Sunil Gamad S/o Gobriya Gamad for grant of regular bail, who has been arrested on 12/07/2024 in connection with Crime No.81/2024 registered at Police Station Raipuriya, District Jhabua (M.P.) for commission of offences under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2)(n) and 376(3) of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the crime.
He has not committed any sexual assault on the prosecutrix.
There is no sufficient evidence available on record to establish the complicity of the accused with the alleged crime.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6598 2 MCRC-10863-2025
Prosecutrix has been examined before the trial Court and she has not supported the prosecution case.
Applicant will abide by all the terms and conditions imposed by this Court.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving his family, home and profession and also there is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by applicant.
Final conclusion of the trial will take considerable long time, therefore, learned counsel prays for allowing the bail application and for grant of bail.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State has vehemently opposed the prayer and prays for dismissal of the bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: In the aforesaid factual backdrop, keeping in view the statement of the prosecutrix, this Court is inclined to grant benefit of bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with separate solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by the said Court, without any default, during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7. The applicant will not indulge himself in any criminal activity in future.

This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and / or breach of any of the conditions of bail, the prosecution NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6598 3 MCRC-10863-2025 will be at liberty to move appropriate application for cancellation of bail.
8. The concerned Court shall get the conditions reproduced on the personal bond by the accused and on surety bond by the surety concerned.
If any of them is unable to write, the scribe shall certify that he had explained the conditions to the concerned accused or the surety.
9. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
